arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && cat > memcheck.py << 'PYEOF'
import resource, subprocess, sys, time
f = sys.argv[1]
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","/app/submission/scheduler.py"], stdin=open(f,"rb"), stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print(f, "rc",p.returncode, "wall %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), "cpu %.2fs"%(ru.ru_utime+ru.ru_stime), "maxrss %.1f MiB"%(ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
python3 memcheck.py big_stream.json; python3 memcheck.py big_burst.json; python3 memcheck.py big_idle.json
echo "--- with 1GiB address space limit:"
( ulimit -v 1048576; python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < big_stream.json > /dev/null ) && echo "stream OK under 1GiB"
( ulimit -v 1048576; python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < big_burst.json > /dev/null ) && echo "burst OK under 1GiB"
